title: Chapter 151 Wang Shuo Changes His Job To A Military Commander
content:
Chapter 151 Wang Shuo Changes His Job To A Military Commander

Wang Shuo returned to the meeting room, took out the transfer certificate, and immediately clicked to use it.

[Are you sure you want to transfer to a general? ]

"Yes."

[It is detected that the player still has a large number of free attribute points that have not been allocated. Do you want to allocate them according to the general template? ]

"Yes."

Wang Shuo found that all his free attributes were added to the basic attributes in a ratio of 3:3:2:2.

Suddenly, he felt a warm current flowing through his body, and Wang Shuo moaned comfortably.

【ID: SAC5678 Wang Shuo】

【Level: Level 24】

【Strength: 119 (39+80)】

【Constitution: 93 (43+50)】

【Agility: 56 (53+3)】

【Energy: 46 (45+1)】

【Life skills: 1. Smooth the waters, 2. Make a mud pit】

(Qualification: B level, each level up provides 4 free attribute points.)

【Combat attribute panel】

【Attack power: 100+119+6】

【Defense power: 200】

【Command value: 3 8]

[Reputation: 1850]

[Health: 3330]

[Experience: 12000/240000]

[Skills: "Dragon Spear Art" (Level 3)]

[Combat skills: 1. Summoning mud puppets, 2. Breaking illusion eyes, 3. Dragon attack, 4. Flame breath; 5. Iron chain binding, 6. Flame shield, 7. Horsemanship (Level 3)]

[Equipment: 1. Flame Spear (Excellent); 2. Nine Dragons Gold Patterned Ao; 3. Red Flame Armor; 4. Crocodile leather boots; 5. Rebound necklace; 6. Horse brand. ]

And after the job transfer, various basic attributes and defense power will be increased by 20% on the original basis.

"Haha..."

An unprecedentedly powerful feeling filled Wang Shuo's heart, and he wanted to vent.

The best place to vent is naturally the ancient battlefield.

It's time to experience the strength of the high-level skeletons here.

In the afternoon, Wang Shuo came directly to the Yellow Wind Valley camp.

"Old Zhao, what are you busy with?" Wang Shuo saw from afar that Zhao Bangde was in deep thought.

"Haha, just thinking about some things in the past!"

Wang Shuo showed an intriguing expression. It seems that Old Zhao is also a man with a story.

"What are you doing today?"

"I want to explore the ancient battlefield. How many places are there that I can't set foot on now?"

Zhao Bangde looked at Wang Shuo, thought about it, and then smiled faintly: "Ayub, you can already push the red area horizontally. Now only the core area with the darkest color is left!"

"As long as you advance step by step, it shouldn't be a big problem."

With the affirmation of Old Zhao, Wang Shuo was instantly full of confidence.

For safety reasons, Wang Shuo still asked Li Jianguo to bring 2 bronze crossbow carts.

The militia team was left to watch the house.

The average level of Wang Shuo's golden fire cavalry is already 22, while the militia team is lower, with an average of only 20.

It seems that they need to be transferred as soon as possible.

"Let's go! The target core area." Wang Shuo pointed his spear, led the way, and rushed out.

In the yellow area, there were low-level skeleton soldiers. At this time, Wang Shuo could ignore these low-level skeleton soldiers of only a few levels.

Continuing forward, he came to the area of skeleton knights. Skeleton knights of more than ten levels were easily knocked off by Wang Shuo without any difficulty.

Further ahead, it was the area where ghosts and wronged souls wandered.

From a distance, Wang Shuo saw a wandering ghost.

At this moment, Wang Shuo remembered many unpleasant memories.

That was when he was only a few levels, and he was chased by ghosts and had no way to go up to the sky or down to the ground. The embarrassed appearance seemed to be still vivid.

Wang Shuo immediately took out the soul defense talisman and the soul attack talisman.

It's time to avenge the previous shame!
